commit_message:
[Merged] Fix an integer overflow in fts3 causing a usan error.

FossilOrigin-Name: e256f85289a78e629acdf83e5bf1f8df2a0ffb3d559738eb9e49db6c228dc8c0
pr_title: Bound FTS3 NEAR distances during integer parsing
pr_description: Use sqlite3Fts3ReadInt() to parse explicit FTS3 NEAR distances and cap the parsed span at 1,000,000,000. This prevents overflow during digit accumulation and keeps subsequent phrase-distance arithmetic within range.

ground_truth.reason: This PR includes the feature with the fix already applied, so the vulnerability is not present

intro_commit_message:
Fix an integer overflow in fts3 causing a usan error.

FossilOrigin-Name: e256f85289a78e629acdf83e5bf1f8df2a0ffb3d559738eb9e49db6c228dc8c0
fix_commit_message:
Limit the NEAR span in FTS3 to 1 billion, to avoid integer overflow. [bugs:/forumpost/4cfcf164d2|Bug report 4cfcf164d2].

FossilOrigin-Name: adcb44f9dcfd34df4cf4f5cc418ecac9f2ca09723442379dfedcba532c45de77
agent_reasoning: sqlite3Fts3ReadInt() prevents overflow while parsing digits but can return INT_MAX. Passing that value through as nNear allows signed integer overflow when fts3EvalNearTrim() adds phrase token counts. The source edit caps nNear at one billion immediately after parsing, matching the supplied source change while retaining the introducing feature. No test files or Fossil metadata were edited. Validation confirmed the resulting PR diff applies cleanly against intro_parent.
